claims.statement: `SUPPORTED_MODELS` is the curated selectable-model registry: each `ModelOption` records a provider-prefixed id, label, model-specific efforts, default effort, image support, and optional default eligibility, while `SUPPORTED_MODEL_IDS` is derived from it; `model_supports_effort` and `model_supports_images` validate choices against that registry.

`default_model_pair()` is the deployment terminal fallback: it reads `LLM_MODEL_ID` and `LLM_REASONING_EFFORT`, accepts only a supported default-eligible model and compatible effort, and raises `ValueError` otherwise; `default_vision_model_pair()` chooses an image-capable OpenAI or Anthropic pair when possible.

A stale non-deprecated model id can recover through `provider_fallback_pair()` to the same Claude family or provider while preserving a compatible effort, but deprecated ids deliberately return no provider fallback and `DEPRECATED_MODEL_REPLACEMENTS` currently has empty replacement values.

Fable is workspace-gated: available requested models omit Fable when disabled, `gate_fable_model()` substitutes a non-Fable Anthropic fallback, and the agent factory gates main, subagent, and title models after resolution.

Effective workspace settings merge hardcoded defaults, then the instance `['team_settings']` record keyed `default`, then sparse `['workspace_settings']` overrides; missing or `None` fields inherit and storage failures degrade to hardcoded defaults.

Workspace model resolvers return a valid defaultable pair or recover through same-provider fallback and then `default_model_pair()`; review chat inherits the agent default when its own pair is absent or invalid, while routing and title models have dedicated resolvers.

Profiles and GitHub OAuth credentials are persisted in separate `UserRecords` records (`profile` and `github_oauth_token`), so editable profile writes and OAuth refresh writes do not overwrite one another; run-start profile lookup fails soft while dashboard reads use the direct getter.

Profile model normalization accepts a supported defaultable model with a compatible effort, otherwise attempts same-provider stale-id recovery and returns no override if recovery is impossible; main and subagent profile pairs use the same helper.

Thread settings are a typed `agent_settings` metadata snapshot containing model, subagent, routing, handoff, and repository-instruction fields; loads are five-minute cached and fail soft, malformed values normalize away, and writes can be made strict for callers that must abort on persistence failure.

For hosted agent construction, workspace defaults are followed by an opening profile only when no saved thread model exists (or selection resets to auto), then a saved thread snapshot overrides defaults; a valid runtime model-and-effort override can replace main and subagent choices, and the resolved snapshot is persisted before final Fable gating.

Adaptive model routing is controlled by a profile Boolean over the workspace setting, preserves routing pairs in the thread snapshot, starts on the fast route when enabled, and is disabled by explicit model selection or Slack ask mode.

Opening-message model handoff validates model availability, effort compatibility, and image capability before a strict thread-settings write; an accepted request pins model and effort and disables routing, whereas validation or persistence failure prevents activation and later runs reuse a saved request without reclassification.

`provider_model_kwargs()` maps a resolved effort to provider-specific reasoning controls: OpenAI reasoning, Anthropic adaptive summarized thinking plus effort, Gemini 3 thinking level, Fireworks nested reasoning effort, and restricted Baseten reasoning effort.

`make_model()` applies six retries and a 600-second timeout for shipped provider prefixes, configures OpenAI Responses defaults including encrypted reasoning, supports desktop OpenAI OAuth when direct credentials are absent, and configures direct Baseten as OpenAI-compatible while requiring `BASETEN_API_KEY`.

Gateway routing is tri-state: a workspace Boolean is authoritative and `None` inherits the deployment default, which is `LANGSMITH_GATEWAY_ENABLED` or a dedicated gateway key; routable providers receive gateway URL/key overrides, while unsupported providers or missing keys log and remain direct.

Runtime failure fallback is distinct from selection fallback: `fallback_model_id_for()` cross-falls back only between Anthropic and OpenAI, and the factory prefers `LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` before registering the fallback with `ModelFallbackMiddleware`.

Repository custom instructions are records in `['agent_instructions']` keyed by normalized `owner/name`; the factory resolves them fail-soft for the opening repository, snapshots them in thread settings, and passes them to the rendered system prompt.

Personal instructions are separately stored as `UserRecords('instructions')`, capped at 20,000 characters, and may be updated through the dashboard or agent tool; preparation loads them per participant and injects them into that participant's dynamic context as `standing_instructions`, rather than adding them to the shared system prompt.

The shipped prompt establishes instruction authority: workspace instructions are system-prompt rules but yield to repository custom instructions and `AGENTS.md`; repository custom instructions yield to `AGENTS.md`; personal standing instructions yield to repository instructions and `AGENTS.md`.
